 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Transpose the framed 1-grid and reverse both output axes."""
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 1]
    if not cells:
        return []
    r0 = min(r for r, _ in cells)
    r1 = max(r for r, _ in cells)
    c0 = min(c for _, c in cells)
    c1 = max(c for _, c in cells)
    height = r1 - r0 + 1
    width = c1 - c0 + 1
    return [
        [grid[r0 + height - 1 - j][c0 + width - 1 - i] for j in range(height)]
        for i in range(width)
    ]

if __name__ == "__main__":
    import json, sys
    print(json.dumps(transform(json.load(sys.stdin))))
